rounds.notes:
For this round, focus on making money, to do this make sure to be constantly healing your team as they are much easier to hit than the enemy and grants plenty of cash from assists, and in between look for damage options on enemies to further boost this.

Remember that just because this is a Blaster build, you should still be lining up your Pulsars to hit multiple allies/enemies as often as you can, especially early on as this really boosts cash gain.

You can choose between [Stinger](item_e9d0d530-d620-4e74-a34d-38cdebfeb9a4) and [MediMaster](item_a04e1041-01c1-46ed-801e-d0590003e9b6), as both are great, but unless you have very good aim I find [Stinger](item_e9d0d530-d620-4e74-a34d-38cdebfeb9a4) to boost your damage more reliably, please note that [Stinger](item_e9d0d530-d620-4e74-a34d-38cdebfeb9a4) does not affect your heals though, whereas [MediMaster](item_a04e1041-01c1-46ed-801e-d0590003e9b6) will.

Early on the combination of [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) and [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) is optimal for heal and damage per second. Don't buy [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) as its effect on [Stinger](item_e9d0d530-d620-4e74-a34d-38cdebfeb9a4) at the moment is negligible and your Pulsars have a long cooldown with only one charge.

If you are worried about survival, then it may be worth buying [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da), [Running Shoes](item_950eccea-31a0-4a55-8c2a-75bf7920e1aa) and [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0). Don't buy [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) as it doesn't have the passive that [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) does and its damage reduction won't kick in until all of your shields are gone first

round_upgrades.notes: This gives you a solid 10 damage on your blaster, and its super easy to proc without having to go for headshots, so you end up doing more damage overall early on, making it a great money generator for round 1

rounds.notes:
Not much to say here, keep farming for money and remember to use [Pulsar Torpedoes](ability_fd63ee02-e01a-49bd-a75d-0e78efafca88) often on multiple people.

[Vantage Shot](item_6d7a0598-07cf-45ea-bbf5-c7e7b975e07a) is very powerful and a must grab as its +20% [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) for 4k, jump constantly to activate it but be wary that if they have very good aim jumping makes your movement more predictable, and if you double jump against hitscans they can easily single you out and pick you off

rounds.notes: Now that you have a decent amount of cash, pick the other power from [MediMaster](item_a04e1041-01c1-46ed-801e-d0590003e9b6) or [Stinger](item_e9d0d530-d620-4e74-a34d-38cdebfeb9a4) and also grab [Long Range Blaster](item_9dfc20e8-9a7b-4576-bdca-d75ada1b369b). You want to be playing within 12-25 metres of your team to make full use of [Long Range Blaster](item_9dfc20e8-9a7b-4576-bdca-d75ada1b369b), however this is still closer than it sounds so make sure to ping them every now and then to ensure you are close enough to proc the extra stats from it. Keep prioritising healing but now that you have [Long Range Blaster](item_9dfc20e8-9a7b-4576-bdca-d75ada1b369b) you can do some solid damage from the backline to the enemy team, and can fight back a lot more easily on anybody diving you.

rounds.notes: Continue building [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) in roughly equal amounts, both are very important for Juno due to her gun having a pretty fast base attack speed, allowing the % to have a more significant impact than say a [Cassidy](hero_3dd63854-7558-4344-86e4-b506f807129b) who will want to solely prioritize [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power). [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) is a great value for money item to balance both.

rounds.notes: Here is where the build really picks up its heals, and pivots much more into burst healing. The combination of [Pulse Spike](item_6557a6d1-9c94-4635-9619-67257e26683e) and [Medicinal Missiles](item_30eeab6c-4a1e-4a16-b9dd-e83d633caa40) is very strong, and you will want to base your playstyle around this. Start off a fight by staying safe and shooting enemies, until your team takes some damage, then quickly make use of your [Pulsar Torpedoes](ability_fd63ee02-e01a-49bd-a75d-0e78efafca88) increased speed and heal boost, to then trigger a huge attack speed bonus and quickly burst them up to full health, then go back to shooting the enemy while your cooldown comes back. This doesn't mean to ignore your team while [Pulsar Torpedoes](ability_fd63ee02-e01a-49bd-a75d-0e78efafca88) are on cooldown, but remember that you can fix them up extremely quickly if they survive until your next cycle is ready.

round_upgrades.notes: Core of our late game build, its huge attack speed allows you to perform "cycles" of healing when combined with your Pulsars, enabling you to dps more inbetween cooldowns

rounds.notes: You have some choices on what to pick for your powers now, I recommend [Pulsar Plus](item_4795ae1f-580d-47ec-a01d-0933cba56212) as this effectively halves the duration you have to wait between cycles, and greatly improves sustain for your team. [Hyper Healer](item_108336b3-54d2-4d69-8ea4-c2da5affb7ca) however is an honourable mention and can be good against something like a [Winston](hero_a0ebe5ef-69a6-4a8f-9360-7b7fed8bce88) diving your team, where what you really need is to get out as fast as possible, and the extra survivability helps to heal you as well as everyone else that has been dove.
